BATHULA SRAVANI

POWER PLATFORM DEVELOPER

 sravanibathula873@gmail.com  9353377591	 Bengaluru,India  linkedin.com/in/bathula-sravani-984860227

CAREER PROFILE

 Overall 3+ years of experience in building enterprise solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, and SharePoint.

 Skilled in developing responsive Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps with Dataverse integration.

 Strong expertise in workflow automation, approvals, notifications, and data processing using Power Automate.

 Hands-on experience creating reusable components, custom forms, galleries, and role-based applications.

 Proficient in integrating Power Platform with Outlook, Teams, Excel, SQL, and SharePoint for real- time data operations.

 Experienced in troubleshooting, app performance optimization, and ensuring secure data access.  Ability to convert business requirements into scalable, user-friendly, and efficient digital solutions.

 Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams for requirement gathering and project delivery.

 Quick learner with solid analytical and problem-solving abilities.

 Committed to delivering high-quality, business-efficient, and user-focused solutions.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Primary Skills: Microsoft Power Apps(canvas & Model Driven Apps), Power Automate, Microsoft 365 Integration, Power Pages

Database Technologies: Sharepoint Online, Microsoft Dataverse, salesforce,SQL Server, On Premises data gateway

Integration & Automation: REST APIs, AI Builder.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Working as a Software Engineer at Samsung India

PROJECT DETAILS

Project 1: Recruitment & Candidate Tracking System

09/2022 – 12/2025

Bengaluru,India

Power Apps (Model-Driven), Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, SharePoint

Description: The Recruitment & Candidate Tracking System is a digital platform that automates and centralizes the entire hiring process—from job postings to candidate onboarding—using Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse.

Key Features:



Designed and developed a Model-Driven Power Apps solution with Dataverse tables for managing job openings, candidates, and interview workflows.

Built automated Power Automate flows for resume parsing, interview scheduling, offer letter generation, and recruiter/manager notifications.

Integrated AI Builder to extract candidate skills and experience from uploaded resumes for faster shortlisting.

Implemented Power Pages for external candidates to apply and upload documents securely into the system.

Project 2: Visitor Management & Access Control System

Power Apps (Canvas + Power Pages), Dataverse, Power Automate , Microsoft Teams, SharePoint

Description: The Visitor Management & Access Control System is a digital solution that replaces paper logbooks with a kiosk-based platform for visitor registration, host approvals, and QR-based entry badges ,tracks real-time check-ins/outs through Dataverse and helps organizations improve security, compliance, and overall visitor handling efficiency.

Key Features:

 Designed and developed the kiosk-based visitor registration app using Power Apps to capture visitor details, ID proof, and host selection.

 Built automated approval workflows in Power Automate, including Teams adaptive card notifications for host approval or rejection.

 Developed QR code badge generation and printing process integrated with Power Automate Desktop.

 Implemented security roles, Dataverse data model, and Power BI dashboards for real-time visitor analytics and compliance reporting.

Project 3: Facility Booking & Space Utilization App

Power Apps (Canvas), Dataverse, Power Automate, Microsoft Graph API, Outlook Calendar, Microsoft Teams.

Description:The Facility Booking & Space Utilization App is a digital system that automates and manages real-time booking of rooms, vehicles, and workspaces using Dataverse and Outlook Calendar, eliminating conflicts and improving facility utilization.

Key Features:

 Designed and developed the facility booking app with real-time calendar and Dataverse integration.

 Built Power Automate flows for booking creation, conflict checking, approvals, and QR generation.

 Configured Outlook & Graph API connections to block calendar slots automatically.

EDUCATION	

Bachelor Of Technology(B.Tech)

GIET Engineering College

Electronics and communication Engineering

08/2019 – 04/2023

Rajahmundry,India
